candidates.name: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) disease
support_spans: Viral resistance testing showed mutations in UL97 (C592G) and UL54 (N408K) genes
candidates.why: The patient's CMV infection is likely due to the viral mutations, which may be contributing to the disease.

candidates.name: Immunodeficiency-related illness

HIV with undetectable viral load, CD4 count 140 cells/µL on therapy
candidates.why: The patient's immunodeficiency is likely contributing to the development of opportunistic infections.
